entities.summary: Alexander Alexandrovich Alexeyev is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman for the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract with the Pittsburgh Penguins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 31st overall by the Washington Capitals in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
